description: This file defines classes and enums for AES encryption and decryption, including key management and initialization vector handling, within the WPEFramework::Crypto namespace.

classes.name: AESEncryption
classes.description: Class for AES encryption operations, managing key setup and encryption process.

classes.name: AESDecryption
classes.description: Class for AES decryption operations, managing key setup and decryption process.

methods.name: InitialVector
methods.description: Gets or sets the initialization vector for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the encryption/decryption key with specified length.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data of specified length.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data of specified length.
